notes:
v4.6.112 — Crypto bots are Alpaca-only + Alpaca $10 crypto-order minimum

🪙 IBKR has no reliable crypto market data, so a crypto bot placed on IBKR could never price or buy (it just showed 0 cash and sat idle). Crypto bots now run on Alpaca only — enforced in the AI bot-builder, the IBKR allocation table, and the server (which auto-retires any crypto bot stuck on IBKR). If you had one on IBKR, re-create it on Alpaca.

💵 Fixed Alpaca crypto buys failing with 'cost basis must be >= 10'. Alpaca rejects crypto orders under $10; bots now bump a too-small buy up to the $10 floor when cash allows, or skip it cleanly instead of erroring.

Update via the in-app banner.
